verdict.summary: Weekly scoped SEO-360 (2026-10-26), 6 specialists: gsc-data-analyst, ga4-data-analyst, technical-seo-engineer, internal-linking-engineer, index-coverage-analyst, seo-qa-auditor (SHIP WITH FIXES, applied). Review gate: C5, C6, C7 STILL_TRUE; C2-C4 stay FIXED (C2 fixed on live page per WebFetch, GSC recrawl pending); 0 regressed, 0 unknown, 0 new criticals. C6 worsened: 28d GSC clicks 879 vs 1085 prior (-19.0%), impressions -19.7%; weekly clicks fell from 268 (week of 9/21) to 177 (-34%), gradual not a step. 186 of 206 lost clicks sit on homepage/careers/google-listing-tagged pages with stable position (brand terms included; brand vs non-brand split still needed); the large position drops (e.g. 13->58, 6->64) are on pages with 0-5 prior clicks. All 6 inspected URLs are indexed with no defect found, cause not established. GA4 organic sessions -10.5%; lead events (form_submission -35%) unverified, tracked as H5. C5 narrowed to ~240 older global blog posts (older sample 1/6 with money link; recent 5/6). C7 kept open: redirecting /us/rcm-roi-calculator/ still in sitemap-main.xml; root soft-404 not re-provable via WebFetch. Not sent to specialists: schema/JSON-LD (no raw-HTML tooling), CWV, entity/E-E-A-T, brand SERP, AEO.
